verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a hosted, branded careers page or custom-domain support. It only shows a Careers Site API for displaying job offers on 'your custom website', which is a developer building block that needs engineering work, plus XML job-board feeds, which are an adjacent feature. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work
